compliance.consent: By submitting, you agree that we may contact you by phone, text or email about your request. Message and data rates may apply. Consent is not a condition of purchase. Reply STOP to opt out of texts.

rules.name: License number missing from advertising
rules.fix: Add the affiliated licensee's number, for example "Lic TACLA12345C", to at least one description or the page footer.

rules.name: TDLR consumer notice on proposals, invoices, contracts and signage
rules.fix: Add: Regulated by The Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation, P.O. Box 12157, Austin, Texas 78711, 1 800 803 9202, 512 463 6599.

rules.name: Lapsed federal tax credit advertised
rules.cite: IRS 25C (property placed in service after Dec 31, 2025 excluded); FTC Act §5; DTPA §17.46(b)
rules.fix: Remove credit language for 2026 installs. Mention Oncor's program only with the current program year's terms.

rules.name: Credit trigger term without required disclosures
rules.cite: Regulation Z, 12 CFR §1026.24(d)
rules.fix: State the APR, the terms of repayment and the down payment, or drop the specific term and say "Financing options available, subject to credit approval."

rules.name: "Free" offer: conditions must be clear
rules.cite: 16 CFR Part 251 (Guide Concerning Use of the Word Free)
rules.fix: State every condition next to the offer (for example "free estimate on system replacement; service calls billed").

rules.name: Guarantee or warranty claim without stated terms
rules.cite: FTC Act §5; 16 CFR Part 239 (Guides for Advertising Warranties and Guarantees); DTPA §17.46(b)(20)
rules.fix: Say what is guaranteed, for how long, and how to claim it, or link the terms beside the claim.

rules.name: Superiority or price claim needs substantiation
rules.cite: FTC Policy Statement on Substantiation; DTPA §17.46(b)(5),(7)
rules.fix: Cite the basis (for example "4.9 stars from 708 Google reviews, Sep 2026") or remove the claim.

test.pattern: (#\s?1\b|number one|best (hvac|ac|price|in )|lowest price|cheapest|top rated|highest rated|most trusted|beat any price)

rules.name: Review or rating claim must match real reviews
rules.cite: FTC Trade Regulation Rule on Consumer Reviews and Testimonials, 16 CFR Part 465 (effective Oct 21, 2024)
rules.fix: Match the count and rating to the live profile and date it; never gate or buy reviews.

rules.name: False urgency or countdown
rules.cite: FTC Act §5 (dark patterns); DTPA §17.46(b)(9),(11)
rules.fix: Use a real end date or remove the deadline.

test.pattern: (only \d+ (spots|slots|units|left)|offer ends in|today only|act now|last chance|expires tonight)

rules.name: Misstated R22 or refrigerant rule
rules.cite: EPA Section 605 phaseout; Technology Transitions rule as amended May 26, 2026
rules.fix: Operating an R22 or R410A system is legal. Say what is true: R22 is no longer produced, and new split systems use A2L refrigerants.

test.pattern: (r[\s-]?22|r[\s-]?410a|freon)[^.]{0,40}(illegal|banned to use|must be replaced|outlawed|no longer legal)

rules.name: Contractor offering to handle or negotiate an insurance claim
rules.cite: Tex. Ins. Code ch. 4102 (a contractor may not act or advertise as a public adjuster, §4102.163); Tex. Ins. Code ch. 707 (paying or waiving a deductible)
rules.fix: Offer inspection, photos and a written quote; say the claim is between the homeowner and the insurer. Never offer to waive or pay a deductible.

test.pattern: (we (will |can |)(handle|negotiate|manage|settle) (your |the )?(insurance )?claim|deal with your insurance( company)?|work(s)? directly with your insurance|we'?ll handle the claim|waive (your |the )?deductible|pay (your |the )?deductible)

rules.name: Efficiency rating claim
rules.cite: FTC Energy Labeling Rule, 16 CFR Part 305; AHRI certified ratings
rules.fix: Quote the AHRI certified rating of the matched system (condenser plus coil or air handler), not the condenser alone.

rules.name: ENERGY STAR mark use
rules.cite: ENERGY STAR Identity Guidelines
rules.fix: Use the mark only for certified models and never as a company endorsement.

rules.name: "Licensed and insured", "bonded" or "certified" claims
rules.cite: DTPA §17.46(b)(5); EPA 40 CFR Part 82 Subpart F for Section 608
rules.fix: Keep proof on file: certificate of insurance, NATE or 608 cards, the manufacturer dealer letter.

test.pattern: (licensed (and|&) insured|bonded|nate certified|epa certified|factory authori[sz]ed|elite dealer|diamond contractor)

rules.name: Availability claim (24/7, same day)
rules.fix: Only if staffed. Same day claims need a stated cutoff time.

rules.name: Texting without documented consent
rules.cite: TCPA 47 U.S.C. §227; Texas Bus. & Com. Code ch. 302 as amended by SB 140 (Sep 1, 2025)
rules.fix: Unchecked consent box, disclosure that consent is not a condition of purchase, STOP instructions; register under chapter 302 if the exemption does not apply.

test.pattern: (text you|we'?ll text|send you texts|sms updates|text message offers)
test.unless: (consent|stop to opt out|reply stop|not a condition)

rules.name: Editorial: exclamation or gimmicky capitals in a headline
rules.cite: Google Ads Editorial policy
rules.fix: Remove the exclamation mark or recase the word.

rules.name: Phone number inside ad text
rules.cite: Google Ads Editorial policy (use call assets)
rules.fix: Move the number to a call asset.

rules.name: Personal attribute assertion
rules.cite: Meta Advertising Standards, personal attributes
rules.fix: Describe the offer, not the person.

rules.name: Financing offer may require the Financial products special ad category
rules.cite: Meta special ad categories (Financial products and services, 2025)
rules.fix: Run financing creative in a separate campaign under the special ad category (15 mile radius minimum, no ZIP, age or gender targeting) or remove financing from ZIP-targeted ad sets.
